replies.text:
Check of commonly-missed threats against this design:

- Automated abuse (brute force, mass sign-up, email/SMS flooding, scraping): design has no sign-in, form or API — only "Database backups are written nightly to a cloud storage bucket." Not present.
- Staff/admin screens rendering user-supplied content: no UI, moderation or upload surface described. Not present.
- Privileged actions with no record (delete, approve, move money, role change): design describes no admin action flow; deletion of backups and untraceable downloads are already covered by listed threats 2 and 4. Covered.
- Personal/account pages cacheable by browsers, proxies or CDNs: no web response or document delivery in the design. Not present.
- Attacker-controlled text flowing into logs, CSV/spreadsheet exports, emails or headers: design mentions no logging, export or email path. Not present.
- Single-reviewer threats: the credential/secret-in-dump escalation items (#2, #5) rest on what "a full database dump typically contains", which the design never states — speculation about contents, so excluded. The public-bucket-misconfiguration item (#1) and the "reporting only needs aggregates" item (#6) are variants of listed threat 1 (same weakness, same harm). The repudiation item (#4) duplicates listed threat 4.
